title: lilium harrisianum
intro: Lilium harrisianum, commonly known as Harris' lily or Harris' trumpet lily, is a species of lily native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Lilium harrisianum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and antibacterial effects.
